text_block_list.text:
The day of Найс Нэйчер's debut race has
finally
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'll probably be talking about "the good
ol' days"
by tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Haha, appearing relaxed is my specialty.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not the debut that matters...
it's what
comes after it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
Just go out there and show off what you've
been working on!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'd more than love to do that if I
had
anything worth showing...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But it wouldn't be a Найс Нэйчер race if I
didn't
screw up on an important day like
this.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm sure I'll do just fine! I guess I'd
better be
off.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
